description: A protein is a physical component of a Reactome macromolecular complex represented by a PwGroup. Membership asserts components present together, rather than alternative members of a set.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the relationship; Reactome for this type.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which the relationship was last seen.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: Complexes associated with Signaling Pathways (R-HSA-162582), Immune System (R-HSA-168256), and Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers (R-HSA-5663202), including their descendant pathways. Complexes include those associated with event participants, controllers and active units, and recursively nested complexes. Only proteins with a UniProt reference and an existing matching Protein node are represented.
source_contributions.description: PwGroups retain Reactome compartment and modification variants as separate complexes. Protein compartment and modification variants share the base UniProt Protein node; isoform specificity is retained on the edge when available. Alternative protein sets are not expanded into members, and set membership does not produce these edges. Stoichiometry is not recorded.

properties.name: reactome_isoform_accessions
properties.description: Isoform UniProt accessions of the protein instances contributing this membership.
properties.notes: `UniProtKB:`-prefixed, de-duplicated; union across all slots resolving to the edge. Omitted when every contributing instance referenced a base accession.
